prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, legible at 384x384. Large centered subject with comfortable margins and minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, card frame, border or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated parts. Subject: One single recognizable fantasy dagger bent into a broad shallow boomerang angle, with ONE continuous silver blade, one sharp tip at the left end, one short dark leather grip at the right end and one small brass guard between grip and blade. It flies above a small closed purple thief's coin purse with a clear curved dotted motion trail implying it always returns to its owner. Simple unambiguous silhouette, no forked or doubled blade, no hands, no other weapons.
